name: pm-vcs
description: Branch-aware merge safety for pm trackers. `pm vcs preflight` verifies a clone or fresh worktree can merge tracker data field-aware before an agent starts work; `pm vcs preview <ref>` predicts the exact per-field resolution a real merge would produce, by running the shipped merge primitives against blobs read out of git; `pm vcs items <range>` maps a commit range onto the pm items it created, modified and closed.
author: @unbraind
